name: railway
description: Generates railway.json for the Tovu server. Follow the output notes to create the volume and set secrets before deploying. Config generation only.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Writes the settings file for running the Tovu server on Railway. You follow its notes to finish the deploy.

credentialCards.title: Connect Railway
credentialCards.label: Railway API
credentialCards.intro: Save a Railway token for deploying this site from Tovu. Deploys from Tovu are being added; until then the assistant can only look up your Railway projects with it. Writing the deployment settings file needs no token.
credentialCards.keyHint: In Railway, open Account Settings → Tokens → Create Token and select the workspace that holds the site. The token can do anything in that workspace; Railway has no read-only option.
